Fate Core

Fate Core is a generic, narrative-first tabletop RPG by Evil Hat Productions, built around aspects (phrases describing what’s true and important about a character, place, or situation), fate points, and four core actions: overcome, create an advantage, attack, and defend. Rolls use four Fate dice (each showing +, -, or blank) added to a skill rating and read against the ladder. Characters are defined less by numbers and more by the story-relevant statements attached to them, which can be invoked for a bonus or compelled by the GM to complicate the story in exchange for a fate point.

Rules

Getting Started

  • The Basics — What you need to play, the character sheet, rolling the dice, the ladder, fate points, invoking and compelling aspects
  • Game Creation — What makes a good Fate game, setting up your game, the setting’s big issues, faces and places
  • Character Creation — High concept, trouble, the phase trio, the skill pyramid, stunts and refresh, quick character creation

Core Mechanics

  • Aspects and Fate Points — Types of aspects, invoking, compelling, the fate point economy, creating and discovering aspects in play
  • Skills and Stunts — Building stunts, stunt families, and the full Default Skill List (all 18 skills with actions and stunts)
  • Actions and Outcomes — Opposition, the four outcomes, the four actions (overcome, create an advantage, attack, defend)
  • Challenges, Contests, and Conflicts — Zones, turn order, stress, consequences, extreme consequences, conceding, movement, teamwork

Running the Game

  • Running the Game — The Golden and Silver Rules, setting difficulties, dealing with time, creating the opposition (NPC types), scenes, sessions, and scenarios
  • The Long Game — Arcs, campaigns, milestones (minor, significant, major), and world advancement
  • Extras — The Bronze Rule (Fate Fractal), creating an extra, weapon/armor ratings, superpowers, special gear, cybertech, wealth, vehicles, magic

Reference

  • Character Sheet — Blank character sheet (printable) with interactive generator
  • Cheat Sheet and Veterans’ Guide — Quick-reference notes and what’s changed for players of previous Fate games
  • Appendix I: Open Game License — The full OGL 1.0a text and Fate Core’s copyright notice

Data

  • skills.json — All 18 default skills with actions, descriptions, and example stunts
  • ladder.json — Adjective ladder from Terrible (-2) to Legendary (+8)
